title: 第十七章 四季轮回 天地四灵试炼 道心未竟一劫第十八章 迷雾无心 善妖蒙冤 人心最恶一劫
content_zh:
清鼠妖秽土，复百里农桑。四神离废仓旧地，拂去征尘，复踏西天古道。
自下凡历劫，斩妖、渡鬼、平水、除蛇、灭鼠、度羊、破幻、镇煞，一路杀伐慈悲，九重劫难尽渡。四象神力日渐交融，彼此心意相通，只是道心尚在磨砺，仍存凡世牵绊、荣辱执念、悲欢挂碍。世人只见四神斩妖除魔、所向披靡，却不知天道救世之路，先炼肉身、再炼神通、最后炼心。妖邪为外魔，可斩可灭；幻境为内魔，难破难断。
西行前路，山川渐渐隐去，四野苍茫，万里白雾平铺天地，隔绝凡尘三界。风声骤停，鸟兽绝迹，一股苍茫浩荡、不带善恶的天道威压缓缓笼罩周身。此地无凶煞、无妖鬼，是天地专为天命四象降下的四季心劫试炼。此劫非厮杀之难，乃本心之考，历春夏秋冬四灵幻境，尝圆满、繁盛、别离、寂灭四重轮回，唯有一一勘破执念，道心方能稳固；若有一关沉沦，便会永困幻境，西行之路就此断绝。
王学南止步推演，指尖卦纹尽数紊乱，面色沉凝：“此乃天道心考，外劫已尽，内劫方至。春贪圆满，夏骄繁盛，秋伤别离，冬惧寂灭，一关更比一关险。”
宁洋北青木灵气四散探查，触不到地脉草木，探不到阴阳流转，沉声言道：“我等虽历万千妖祸，却仍未脱凡心，情爱、功名、安逸、不甘，皆是心魔。四季幻境，便是照出心底隐秘执念。”
张忠东握紧火焰灵杖，神色肃然：“前十劫炼我神通，此劫炼我本心，成败在此一念。”
陈学西按紧腰间利刃，眸光冷冽扫过茫茫白雾：“幻境无形，唯有自渡。”
话音未落，漫天白雾轰然翻涌，天地一瞬寂灭，下一刻，春至。
万物复苏，百花漫野，清风和煦，燕语莺啼。枯木抽芽，山河锦绣，万里芳菲，混沌虚无瞬息化作人间最温柔圆满的阳春盛景。此为春之幻境·圆满劫，春灵主生、主团圆、主如愿，以世间极致安稳美好，诱人心生贪恋。
四神瞬间被无形之力分隔，坠入各自专属心劫，彼此隔绝，不闻不见，无从相助，一人一境，独历悲欢。
宁洋北立于青峦春山，故里山河依旧，宗族亲长尽数健在，年少亲友围坐谈笑，乡邻和睦，炊烟袅袅。世间无瘟疫灾厄，无妖邪乱世，无生离死别，人人安康喜乐。耳边不断传来柔声规劝：“洋北，西行济世何其辛苦，放下天命，归乡安居，岁岁春暖，一世安稳，何必以身赴劫，自寻苦楚？”
他本主青木生机，天性慈悲，最喜人间圆满，望着眼前阖家安乐的景象，心底生出贪恋：若能长留此地，苍生无灾，亲友团圆，何尝不是一种圆满？可转念之间，天下受瘟疫折磨的万千百姓哀嚎，在心底骤然响起。他闭眸凝神，沉声一喝：“春景虽美，皆是虚妄！我青龙主生，不为一己安稳，为万民求生！”
一语落下，满园春色轰然凋零，繁花枯萎，春风骤停，春境破。
张忠东坠入阳春皇城盛世，国泰民安，四海升平。他身披荣光，万民朝拜，百官称颂，朱雀烈火普照山河，人间灾厄尽数消散。幻境低语蛊惑：“你一己之力便可平定乱世，受万世敬仰，何须与同伴奔波，受尽风霜？”
朱雀天性热忱，一心济世，最渴望功业圆满，此刻眼前便是毕生所求。可他深知，这盛世是幻境伪造，非自己亲手渡化。他猛然收束圣火，朗声道：“我之火，焚邪祟而非贪功名；我之志，安苍生而非恋荣光！”
皇城盛世顷刻崩塌，功名云烟散尽，春境破。
王学南身处清幽仙山道场，山门鼎盛，师尊健在，同门和乐。终日诵经论道、观星参玄，无俗世奔波，无西行劫难，独得清宁安然。玄武本就喜静避乱，贪恋无扰自在，幻境不断放大这份安逸。他静坐片刻，缓缓睁眼：“玄武镇世，非镇一己清净，乃镇天地苍生。独善其身非道，兼济天下方为真！”
仙山道场碎作流云，春境破。
陈学西立于万里止戈疆场，狼烟散尽，战乱平息。他身披战甲，青史留名，家国安定，百战功成。白虎肃杀，毕生所求便是止戈定乱，此刻如愿以偿。可他眼底清明依旧：“我杀伐止乱，不为万古虚名，只为人间无祸！”
疆场荣光化为虚无，春境破。

四季第一重春劫，四人皆勘破圆满执念，顺利通关。可天道试炼并未结束，天地风色骤变，热浪翻涌，夏至。
烈日悬空，骄阳炽盛，万木葱茏，蝉鸣震天。山河滚烫，万物极盛张扬，此为夏之幻境·繁盛劫，夏灵主盛、主躁、主掌控，以无边强盛放大人心骄矜，使人恃强自傲、执念独断。
宁洋北坠入万顷绿野，自身青木之力催动天地草木疯长，灵泉遍地，万物繁茂。幻境不断拔高他的能力，低语诱惑：“你可执掌天地生机，主宰万物枯荣，自成一方天道，何须听命天命，受他人约束？”
青木慈悲，此刻却生出掌控一切的野心，险些陷入执念。他猛然警醒：“天地自有轮回，我为辅生，非主生；护世，非掌世。顺道而行，不执己功。”
滔天绿意尽数收敛，夏境燥热一空，夏境破。
张忠东身处炎炎火域，自身圣火燎原天地，烧尽世间一切阴暗邪祟，火光普照四海。幻境劝诱：“你火可净世，力可通天，凭一己便可平定天下，何须四人同心，受制于人？”
朱雀刚烈，最易躁进自傲，此刻险些迷失。他收杖敛火，正色道：“天道清平，非我一己之功；火光照世，非为独霸天下。躁进虚妄，皆非本心。”
烈焰尽数消散，夏境破。
王学南立于万星天宫，星轨随他推演，天命祸福由他决断，仿佛洞悉世间一切因果。玄武沉稳，却易困于知见障，妄图掌控天命。他弃去推演，淡然言道：“天机不可尽窥，天命不可独断。守拙守静，方是玄武本真。”
星宫轰然崩塌，夏境破。
陈学西坠入无尽杀伐之域，千妖万魔尽数俯首，他一刀无敌，独尊万法，战力通天。白虎肃杀，极易嗜战孤高。他弃去无上战力，冷声道：“我斩恶不为尊，止乱不为霸。刀藏锋芒，心守谦卑。”
杀伐气焰归零，夏境破。
第二重夏劫，四人破去骄躁执念，试炼继续推进。转瞬之间，长风萧瑟，落叶纷飞，秋临。
千山落木，万物枯黄，雁渡寒潭，天地悲寂。此为秋之幻境·别离劫，秋灵主衰、主悲、主无常，直面生老病死、聚散离合，拷问人心能否承受世事无常，放下无力与遗憾。这是四季之中最诛心的一重劫难，无数修士皆在此道心崩塌。
content_en:
Clear away the dirty soil of rats and demons, and restore hundreds of miles of mulberry trees. The four gods left the old land of the abandoned warehouse, brushed away the dust of war, and resumed their journey on the ancient road to the west.
Since coming down to earth, he has gone through many tribulations, slaying demons, crossing ghosts, leveling water, eliminating snakes, killing rats, saving sheep, breaking illusions, suppressing evil spirits, killing and benevolent along the way, and it is difficult to survive all nine tribulations. The divine power of the four elephants is gradually blending together, and their minds are connected with each other. However, the Taoist heart is still being tempered, and there are still the ties of the world, the obsession with honor and disgrace, and the worries of joy and sorrow. The world only sees the four gods slaying demons and being invincible, but they don't know that the way to save the world is to refine the body first, then the supernatural powers, and finally the heart. Demons are external demons, which can be killed or destroyed; illusions are internal demons, which are difficult to break and break.
On the way westward, the mountains and rivers gradually disappear, the fields are vast, and white mist spreads across the sky and earth, isolating the three realms of the world. The sound of the wind suddenly stopped, the birds and beasts disappeared, and a vast and vast coercion of heaven without good or evil slowly enveloped the whole body. There are no evil spirits or demons in this place. It is a trial of four seasons of heart tribulation sent down by heaven and earth specifically for the four images of destiny. This calamity is not a matter of fighting, but a test of one's own mind. After going through the illusion of the four spirits in spring, summer, autumn and winter, and experiencing the four reincarnations of perfection, prosperity, separation, and annihilation, only by breaking through the obsession one by one can the Taoist heart be stable; if one sinks in one level, he will be trapped in the illusion forever, and the road to the west will be cut off.
Wang Xuenan stopped to deduce, all the hexagram lines on his fingertips were in disorder, and his face was serious: "This is a mental examination of the way of heaven. The external calamity has been exhausted, and the internal calamity will come. Spring greed is complete, summer pride flourishes, autumn hurts separation, and winter fear dies. Each level is more dangerous than the next."
Ningyang Beiqingmu's spiritual energy spread out in all directions, but could not touch the earth's veins, vegetation, or the flow of yin and yang. He said in a deep voice: "Although we have experienced thousands of demons and disasters, we have still not escaped from the ordinary heart. Love, fame, comfort, and unwillingness are all inner demons. The illusion of the four seasons is to reveal the secret obsessions in the heart."
Zhang Zhongdong held the flaming spiritual staff tightly and looked solemn: "The past ten kalpas have refined my magical powers, this kalpa has refined my true heart, success or failure depends on this thought."
Chen Xuexi pressed the sharp knife on his waist tightly, and his cold eyes swept across the vast white fog: "The illusion is invisible, and we can only cross it by ourselves."
Before he finished speaking, the white mist surged into the sky. The heaven and earth became silent for a moment, and the next moment, spring arrived.
Everything is revived, flowers are blooming in the fields, the breeze is gentle, and the birds are singing. Withered trees sprouting, beautiful mountains and rivers, thousands of miles of beauty, and chaos and nothingness instantly transformed into the most gentle and perfect spring scene in the world. This is the illusion of spring and the perfect calamity. The spring spirit governs birth, reunion, and fulfillment of wishes. It uses the ultimate stability and beauty in the world to tempt people to be greedy.
The four gods were instantly separated by invisible forces, and fell into their own exclusive inner tribulations. They were isolated from each other, unable to hear or see, unable to help each other. Each one was in one place, experiencing joys and sorrows alone.
Ningyang is located in the Qingluan Spring Mountain in the north. The mountains and rivers of my hometown are still the same, all the family members are still alive, young relatives and friends sit around talking and laughing, the neighbors are harmonious, and the smoke is curling up. There is no plague or disaster in the world, there is no chaos in the world, there is no separation of life and death, and everyone is healthy and happy. A soft voice of advice kept coming to my ears: "Yangbei, it's so hard to go west to help the world. Let go of your destiny and return to your hometown to live in peace. The spring will be warm every year and you will be stable for the rest of your life. Why risk your life and seek suffering?"
His main character, Qingmu Shengli, has a compassionate nature and likes the perfection of the world the most. Looking at the scene of peace and happiness for his family in front of him, greed arises in his heart: If he could stay here forever, the people would be free from disasters, and his relatives and friends would be reunited, wouldn't that be a kind of perfection? But as soon as I thought about it, the lamentations of thousands of people all over the world who were suffering from the plague suddenly sounded in their hearts. He closed his eyes and concentrated, and shouted in a deep voice: "Although the spring scenery is beautiful, it is all false! I, the Lord of Qinglong, live, not for my own safety, but for the survival of all people!"
As soon as the words fell, the spring scenery in the garden suddenly withered, the flowers withered, the spring breeze stopped suddenly, and the spring environment was broken.
Zhang Zhongdong fell into the prosperous age of Yangchun Imperial City, when the country was peaceful and the people were safe, and the world was at peace. He is clothed in glory, worshiped by all the people, praised by hundreds of officials, the mountains and rivers are illuminated by the red bird fire, and all the disasters in the world are dissipated. The illusion whispers and enchants: "You can calm down the troubled times by yourself and be admired by all generations. Why do you need to run around with your companions and suffer all the hardships?"
Suzaku is passionate by nature, dedicated to helping the world, and most longs for a successful career. At this moment, what he wants in his life is right in front of him. But he knew very well that this prosperous age was a fake illusion.It cannot be transformed by one's own hands. He suddenly closed the holy fire and said loudly: "My fire burns evil spirits rather than greed for fame; my ambition is to bring peace to the people, not glory!"
The prosperous age of the imperial city collapsed in an instant, the clouds of fame and fame disappeared, and the spring realm was broken.
Wang Xuenan lives in a quiet fairy mountain dojo, where the gate is at its peak, his master is still alive, and his fellow disciples are enjoying themselves. Reciting sutras and discussing Taoism, stargazing and studying mysteries all day long, there is no need to run around in the worldly world, no disasters in the journey to the west, only peace and tranquility. Xuanwu likes to be quiet and avoid chaos, and loves to be undisturbed and comfortable, and the illusion continues to amplify this comfort. He sat quietly for a moment and slowly opened his eyes: "Xuanwu suppresses the world, not to suppress one's own purity, but to suppress the world and the common people. It is not Tao to be good for oneself alone, but it is true to help the world at the same time!"
The fairy mountain dojo is broken into flowing clouds, and the spring realm is broken.
Chen Xuexi stood on the battlefield of Wanli Zhizhi. The smoke cleared and the war subsided. Wearing armor, he left his name in history, his family and country were stable, and he succeeded in hundreds of battles. Bai Hu was so anxious that what he wanted all his life was to put an end to the war and end the chaos, and now he got his wish. But the clarity in his eyes remained: "I kill and stop chaos, not for the sake of vain fame throughout the ages, but just to bring peace to the world!"
The glory of the battlefield turned into nothingness, and the spring realm was broken.
In the first Spring Tribulation of the Four Seasons, all four of them overcame their obsession with perfection and successfully passed the level. But the trial of heaven and earth is not over yet. The winds and colors of the heaven and earth change suddenly, heat waves surge, and the summer solstice begins.
The scorching sun hangs in the sky, the sun is blazing, the trees are lush, and the cicadas are chirping. Mountains and rivers are scalding hot, and all things are flourishing. This is the illusion of summer and the calamity of prosperity.
Ning Yangbei fell into vast expanses of green fields, and the power of its own green trees spurred the vegetation in the world to grow wildly. Spiritual springs were everywhere, and everything was luxuriant. The illusion continues to enhance his abilities, whispering temptations: "You can control the vitality of the world, dominate the prosperity of all things, and form your own way of heaven. Why do you need to obey the destiny and be restricted by others?"
Aoki is compassionate, but at this moment he has the ambition to control everything and almost falls into obsession. He suddenly woke up: "Heaven and earth have their own reincarnation. I am a supplementary life, not a main life; I protect the world, not control it. Follow the path and do not cling to my own merits."
All the greenery in the sky has converged, the summer environment has disappeared, and the summer environment has been broken.
Zhang Zhongdong is in the realm of scorching fire, and his own holy fire has set the world on fire, burning away all the darkness and evil in the world, and the fire shines all over the world. The illusion persuades: "Your fire can purify the world, your power can reach the sky, and you can pacify the world by yourself. Why do you need four people to work together and be controlled by others?"
Suzaku is strong-willed, most prone to being impetuous and arrogant, and is almost lost at this moment. He retracted his staff to contain the fire, and said seriously: "It is not my fault that the way of heaven is pure and peaceful; the fire illuminates the world, and it is not for the purpose of dominating the world. It is not the original intention to advance in vain."
All the fierce flames dissipated, and the summer realm was broken.
Wang Xuenan stands in the Heavenly Palace of Ten Thousand Stars, where he can deduce star paths and make decisions about fortune and destiny, as if he has insight into all cause and effect in the world. Xuanwu is calm, but easily trapped in the barriers of knowledge and vision, trying to control destiny. He gave up the deduction and said calmly: "The secrets of heaven cannot be fully understood, and the destiny of heaven cannot be arbitrary. Only by staying humble and quiet can you be the true form of Xuanwu."
The Star Palace suddenly collapsed, and the Xia Realm was broken.
Chen Xuexi fell into the realm of endless killing, and thousands of demons surrendered. He was invincible with one sword, dominated all kinds of magic, and his fighting power reached the sky. The white tiger kills with fear, and can easily become war-loving and aloof. He abandoned his supreme fighting power and said in a cold voice: "I kill evil without respect, and stop chaos without seeking hegemony. The sword hides the edge, and the heart is humble."
The killing arrogance has returned to zero, and the Xia realm has been broken.
In the second summer tribulation, the four of them got rid of their arrogance and obsession, and the trial continued to advance. In a blink of an eye, the wind is blowing, the fallen leaves are flying, and autumn is coming.
Trees have fallen from thousands of mountains, everything is withered and yellow, geese are crossing the cold pond, and the world is sad and silent. This is the illusion of autumn and the calamity of farewell. The spirit of autumn governs decline, sorrow, and impermanence. It confronts birth, old age, illness, and death, gatherings, separations, and reunions, questioning whether the human heart can bear the impermanence of the world and let go of its powerlessness and regrets. This is the most heart-wrenching disaster in the Four Seasons, and countless monks have their hearts broken here.
